patthana23.23:1.1: Nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha. Nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ
patthana23.23:2.1: naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi. Nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ
patthana23.23:3.1: naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
